title: Arc reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its contents in and lifts them 15px as they scroll into view, with an optional stagger step so a row of cards arrives one after another. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation.
notes: needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere (and with reduced motion) the content simply shows
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box: use overflow-clip for crops
name: arc-reveal

props.name: step
props.description: stagger position in a row (0, 1, 2…): each step starts the fade 40px of scroll later
